evidence: 0089 (item 4, owner decisions D1-D10 of 2026-10-26, with D4's alternative) adds read-only facts the website owes from the P4c fix (B1-B3); it changes no stored row, alters no table and adds no audit row. B1: lab.order_route_receives_here() and pharmacy.order_route_receives_here(), through the owner-only ehr.order_route_receives_here(text), answer H4 (identity.order_route_destination_eligible, md5 6b274d9be9056cefc831a9fd92040bc6, which reads no switch) for the live staff session's facility under any purpose, NULL to a member without the kind's receive permission and 42501 without a staff context (a suspended or released facility included); the Lab and Pharmacy work lists and Incoming carry receives. D4's alternative: lab.order_routes_here() and pharmacy.order_routes_here(), through the owner-only ehr.order_routes_here(text), bound and gated the same way, answer {waiting, held}: a sent route of the kind to the session's facility before respond_by (what Incoming lists), and an accepted, completed or cancelled one whose access_ends_at is still ahead (what route access reads); booleans only, no patient, count or reference, no switch read; each is one range of ehr.order_routes_receiving_idx (waiting the last 168 hours; held the last 1272, since access_ends_at <= accepted_at + 1080 hours by 0086's CHECK and the acceptance, ehr.accept_receiving_order_route md5 1d4a77de6316fa95a539d8151c8604df, refuses at respond_by = created_at + 168 hours), planned per call (plan_cache_mode force_custom_plan): about 2 ms per call with 100,000 routes at one laboratory, against 45 ms for a generic plan. B2: identity.admin_find_order_routes (md5 818a4b363e7476edfd22ec690d69aed1) is dropped and created with two trailing columns, access_ends_at (the stored column) and closable (support's Close refusal, identity.admin_close_order_route md5 e0ea834d458863ec19a94b4853e2a32c, negated at the database clock, with the effective state evaluated once per row), given back to its recorded owner with 0086's security, volatility and search path, its grants checked as a set against those recorded before the drop (an extra grant stops the release instead of being lost). B3: identity.admin_order_route_summary (md5 38ca27cad723425a2cab4725c7603e8e) is replaced in place with destination {receivingTypes, review}, mirroring H4's steps 2 and 3; no verification method is exposed; its owner, attributes and ACL are checked unchanged. Preconditions pin the two replaced bodies and thirteen relied-upon bodies (md5 of pg_proc.prosrc measured on 0001-0088), the receiving index (pg_index), and the respond-by and acceptance CHECKs the bounds rest on, validated and exactly 0086's (pg_get_constraintdef compared with the same CHECKs built in the session, as 0088 compares its CHECKs; a CHECK of either name with another definition, or not validated, stops the release), and require one owner for C20 and C21 that may create the six new functions, run and read what the new bodies call and read, and that the applying role may become; the new functions go to that owner. Locks: 0089 itself holds no table lock at any section boundary (measured with pg_locks); its only table locks are two momentary ACCESS SHARE locks, on ehr.order_routes, taken by pg_get_constraintdef in the CHECK precondition, and on identity.order_route_destination_settings, taken by the PL/pgSQL validator resolving C20's %rowtype (measured: with ACCESS EXCLUSIVE held on either table the runner's lock_timeout stops the dry run and the apply after 5 seconds with nothing applied; with it held on ehr.order_route_events, identity.facilities, identity.organizations, identity.organization_applications, identity.organization_products, identity.staff_facility_memberships, identity.patients, auth.accounts, auth.account_roles, platform.control_settings or identity.consent_grants, 0089 applies without waiting). Old images on the new schema: aba7c16's and 22cd47f's Identity, EHR, Lab and Pharmacy pass their order-routes runtime verifier end to end on a 0089 copy (the previous Identity names its 13 C21 columns and spreads C20's jsonb; Lab and Pharmacy call nothing new); 0089 neither replaces nor relies on any function 0088 replaces. Grants: the four Lab and Pharmacy wrappers to their runtimes and hid_schema_test_runtime, C21 again to hid_identity_runtime alone, in the migration and in runtime-grants.sql. Suites: services/ehr-api/test/database/order-routes-contract-fields.integration.sql, with the order-routes privileges and lifecycle suites extended. The website reads each field only when present and may ship in either order.
